findings: At least one schema-required top-level member, initial_state or segments, was absent.
The normalizer admitted a partial mapping, but the generic required-field gate ran before Pydantic/domain finding extraction.
The packet prompt relied on schema identity and did not make the two required roots salient in the plain-route model-visible contract.
No evidence supports transport truncation, output-cap exhaustion, or provider conversion key loss.
Raw and canonical bytes were not persisted, so exact member identity and byte replay must remain unavailable.
recommended_narrow_fix: Make initial_state and segments explicit in the plain-route model-visible contract.
Allow authoritative typed domain findings to precede the generic backstop for Planning partial mappings.
Preserve strict schema, fail-closed authority, bounded recovery, and privacy-safe diagnostics.
